CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_current_org_id()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN NULLIF(COALESCE(current_setting('app.current_org_id', true), ''), '');
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_current_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN COALESCE(current_setting('app.current_role', true), NULL);
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_current_user_id()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN NULLIF(COALESCE(current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), ''), '');
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_current_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN RETURN get_current_role() IN ('admin', 'super_admin', 'system'); END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_current_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN RETURN get_current_role() = 'super_admin'; END;
$function$
